title: Lubrication Oil Level — Low
description: Lubrication oil reservoir level P041 = {val}%. Below recommended level (25%). Lube interval may be affected. Machine will stop at 10%.
probable_cause: Normal oil consumption or minor leak.
diagnostic_steps: Check for oil leaks at guide covers
remedy: Top up reservoir with correct oil grade. Inspect for leaks.
required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.
